verdict.rationale: HeyGen offers automation surfaces (API, batch, MCP, Zapier/n8n/Make integrations), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows the product versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions. Scene-level video revision, storyboard review with the Video Agent, and enterprise audit logs are adjacent features about video content or account activity, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.
